text: Welcome to Task Manager, a simple board app for planning your work. This video walks you through every feature.
To begin, click Create an account. Type your email and a password twice. The bar shows how strong the password is. Weak passwords are refused.
Click Create account, and we send you a confirmation email. Important: this email usually lands in your Spam or Junk folder. Open it there, mark it as not spam, and click the link.
You can also continue with Google, without a password. Or try the app as a guest. Guest boards are removed after seven days.
After you sign in, your start page opens. Workspaces are on the left. Your boards are in the middle, and What's new shows invitations and changes to your cards.
A workspace groups related boards. Click New workspace, give it a name, and name each board. Then click Create workspace.
To make one board, click New board. Start from blank, or from a template, such as Sprint, Bug tracking or Personal.
Or choose Describe it to AI. Write one sentence about your project, and the AI builds a board with columns and starter cards.
This is a board. Each card shows its priority, labels and due date. The progress bar at the top shows how much is done.
To add a card, click Add card under a column, type a title, and press Enter.
Drag a card to move it to another column. With the keyboard, press space to pick it up, use the arrow keys, and press space again.
Click the circle on a card to mark it complete. The progress bar moves forward.
Click Add column to add a column. Click a column name to rename it. The column menu can set a limit, move, archive or delete the column.
Click a card to open it. Write a description, add checklist items, and set the priority, due date and labels.
Attach files up to four megabytes each, and write comments. Type the at sign to mention a board member.
Click Suggest steps, and the AI proposes a checklist for the card. Keep the steps you want, and add them.
Ask AI opens the assistant. Ask about your board, or ask it to make a change. It only acts after you click Confirm.
Use Search cards and the filters to find cards by text, label, priority or status.
The List view shows all cards as a table you can sort.
Voice command lets you speak to the app. For example: add card Buy domain to To Do. You can also type the command. Click Confirm to run it.
The focus timer helps you work in blocks of twenty five or fifty minutes, with short breaks.
The menu at the top right has more: members, activity, background, keyboard shortcuts, archive, templates, and export to Excel.
Change background gives the board a color, or your own photo.
To work with others, click Share. Invite people by email. You can also copy the invitation link, or share it on WhatsApp.
New members start as viewers. You can let them update tasks, or give them full access. You can also turn on a public, read only link, and save a meeting link for Zoom, Meet or Teams.
Open a card and tick a member under Assigned to. They get a notification and an email.
Here is the start page of the invited member. What's new shows the assignment and the meeting invitation, and the bell shows all notifications.
Click the moon to switch to dark mode.
Click Arabic, and the whole app turns right to left. Emails and AI answers follow your language.
Your account menu lets you change your password, turn email notifications on or off, sign out, or delete your account.
That is Task Manager. Remember: look in your Spam or Junk folder for the confirmation email. Thank you for watching.
